name: Honoo no Seirei
source:
At the mouth of a shrine where locals worship a flame spirit, 
a man and woman stand with troubled expressions. 
Their daughter is in peril of being "taken" by the spirit. 
Seeing if there's anything you can do, you have them bring you 
to the location of the daughter... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165077.html]DLsite English[/url]]
